gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Fat glowing tubes of letter, all one stroke width, make Tilt Neon loud. Noto Sans Grantha sits underneath with tall, pen-nib bowls pressed flat, and a long read never snags on a closed-up shape.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Tilt Neon hits like a bent steel rod, bold and splayed at the c. Noto Sans Gujarati is the pair's best trick, curved strokes that stop short of turning inward, leaving tall a, e and s wide open.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-go: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi marks its lowercase as tall as a thick crayon stroke, with terminals cut back to leave big gaps. Tilt Neon is best at bold, unthinning bowls; the body font is best at breathing room.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Clean, wide-eyed letters fill Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, with every e and a open and a deep middle band. Tilt Neon outlines its counters in one steady line above them.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP reads tall and professional, its curves sweeping open instead of curling shut. Noto Sans JP keeps a long stretch moving smoothly, while Tilt Neon above holds one stylus-like pressure throughout.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi reads with an open channel in every e, and its lowercase fills the line almost like capitals. Tilt Neon's round letters, bent like wire, sit above it as a loud partner.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada is approachable and contemporary. Its gentle bump from small letters up to capitals and s curves that open wide at both ends make it easy company beneath Tilt Neon's drawn-wire strokes.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Neutral and clean, Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends away before each curve closes. Capitals stand barely taller than the lowercase, so a long read stays smooth under Tilt Neon.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Approachable, with Tilt Neon's monoline strokes running stem to serif, and loud for it. Noto Sans Kharoshthi does the opposite best, laying a thick, dark stripe of open curves through every line.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer has generous openings, like a chisel notch in wood, and small letters standing proud. Noto Sans Khmer sits beside Tilt Neon's marker-like constant line, and the two feel loud and clean at once.
